description: This class includes the manufacture of general-purpose machinery not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of weighing machinery: non-domestic scales, platform scales, scales for continuous weighing, weighbridges, weights
manufacture of filtering and purifying machinery for liquids and gases: industrial filtering and purifying equipment for water, beverages, oil, gas
manufacture of industrial refrigerating and air conditioning equipment: refrigerating and freezing equipment for industrial uses, air conditioning machines
manufacture of distilling or rectifying plant
manufacture of machinery for liquefying air or gas
manufacture of gaskets and similar joints made of metal foil
manufacture of automatic vending machines: food and beverage dispensers, ATM machines not elsewhere classified
manufacture of packaging machinery: machinery for filling, sealing, wrapping, labelling
excludes: manufacture of domestic refrigerators and freezers, see 2750
manufacture of domestic air conditioners, see 2750
manufacture of centrifuges for isotope separation, see 2660
